messages:
Ravi Singh: Hey folks 3- moved my home from TX to NY and updated Workday on 2026-01-05. My 01/15 paycheck still shows TX state withholding and employer SUTA tied to TX. Can payroll confirm whether the employer-side unemployment situs should change and whether a retro fix is possible? Also W-2 mailing needs to go to NY.

Marta Diaz: @Ravi thanks. Can you confirm the Workday timestamp and upload the confirmation email? We need that to validate effective date before flipping employer tax situs.

Ravi Singh: I updated on 2026-01-05 at ~9:12am (Workday confirmation attached). Employee ID 94521, last4 1122. Prefer retro adjustment if employer-side taxes can be reallocated to NY for payruns after 01/05.

Sam Youn: Looping in payroll and tax. Quick note: employer SUTA/FUTA rules vary; moving employee doesn't always change employer liability for past wages in the quarter. We can change withholding for employee taxes going forward and run a retro for state withholding, but employer SUTA may require state filings or journal entries.

Ivy (tax): Correct. For mid-quarter moves, employer SUTA situs can depend on payroll presence and where services are performed. If services moved to NY on 01/05, we should be able to treat wages after that date as NY for SUTA prospectively; retro SUTA reallocation for prior payruns is possible in some states but often involves amend returns. We'll try to adjust payroll records and note any employer-side filings needed.

Sam Youn: Action plan: 1) update home/work address in payroll to NY; 2) submit retro to reclass employee state withholding for runs 2026-01-15 and 2026-01-31 to NY where appropriate; 3) leave employer SUTA on TX for wages paid before 01/05 and evaluate whether NY requires amended SUTA for any portion; 4) update W-2 mailing address to NY. Any objections?

Ravi Singh: That sounds fine. I prefer payroll to handle employee withholding retro and then let me know if I need to supply any additional docs for employer-side.

payroll-bot: Retro job queued: job id retro-2026-94521-01. Estimated completion ~10m.

payroll-bot: Retro job retro-2026-94521-01 completed. Changes: employee state withholding reallocated to NY for runs 2026-01-15 and 2026-01-31; NY mailing address set for W-2s. Employer SUTA left as TX for wages prior to 2026-01-05; payroll created tax note for state-team review (note id tax-note-94521-2026). Net changes: employee net increased by $9.45 across adjusted runs. No W-2c required.

Marta Diaz: I'll email you the summary and add next steps for the payroll/state tax team to assess potential amended SUTA requirements.

Ravi Singh: Thanks everyone 2- please include the payroll job id and the tax-note id in the confirmation email for my records.
